title: Add in-app guidance and clearer navigation for adding products (admin workflow)

requirements.text: Add a concise “How to add products” help section to the top of the /admin Product Management page that explains the exact steps an admin should take (login, open Admin/Manage Products, click “Add Product”, fill required fields, save), and clearly lists required fields (Product Name, Category, Description, Image URL, Affiliate URL) vs optional fields (Brand, Price).
acceptanceCriteria: When an admin visits /admin, a visible help/instructions block is shown above the product table/empty state.
The instructions are written in English and explicitly mention which fields are required vs optional.
The instructions mention that Image URL and Affiliate URL must be valid URLs.

requirements.text: Improve admin navigation labeling so admins can more easily find where to add products by renaming the header nav item currently labeled “Admin” to “Manage Products” (still routing to /admin) in both desktop and mobile navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: If the user is an admin, the header shows a navigation item labeled “Manage Products” that navigates to /admin.
The same “Manage Products” label appears in the mobile menu for admins.

requirements.text: When a category page has no products and the current user is an admin, add a secondary call-to-action in the empty state (e.g., a button) that navigates directly to /admin to add the first product for that category.
acceptanceCriteria: On /fashion, /jewelry, and /luxury, if there are zero products in that category and the viewer is an admin, the empty state includes a button that navigates to /admin.
If the viewer is not an admin, the category empty state remains informational only (no admin CTA).

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or any files in frontend/src/components/ui.
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor; do not introduce additional backend services.
nonGoals: Do not implement new product CRUD capabilities (create/edit/delete already exists).
Do not change role assignment or introduce new authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
Do not add third-party CMS or external databases for product management.
